notes_for_editor: Status rests on one undated FFLA directory line. Not on the NHLR Virginia list. The Forest Lookouts index has two North Mountain entries (Frederick and Shenandoah counties); I could not confirm from the sources read which one matches the FFLA coordinates. A search snippet mentioned an owner and a status date in a separate FFLA Virginia database, but I could not open a page showing those fields, so no owner is recorded. The brief's county, status and coordinates match the FFLA list.
